stage1.interpretation: Rank/percentile describe learned Q, not true action quality.

stage2_design.sampling: 128 nonterminals and 128 terminals, with replacement per step
stage2_design.normalization: Separate class means; no empirical-frequency importance correction
stage2_design.target_critics_actor_alpha: Frozen; no target updates or actor/alpha optimization
stage2_design.optimizer: Deep-copied saved critic Adam state; same saved learning rate
stage2_design.mode: eval, gradients enabled only on copied q1/q2
stage2_design.guard: Require <=0.145 AND <=1.2*measured baseline in both sampling seeds

limitations: Held episodes were seen during original training; held out only from these copy updates.
